name: Classic+ combat: vanilla armor constant at level 60, WotLK above
contract: Needs ClassicPlus.CombatRules=1 (default). The attackers are Mages, which carry no armor penetration. The fixtures have fixed template levels and ArmorModifier 1, so they carry the stock unit_class 1 base armor: 3750 for Hevram Bristol (level 60) and 4047 for Illusory Wraith (level 61). Vanilla 1.12 mitigates armor / (armor + 85 * attackerLevel + 400), so a level-60 attacker takes 1000 * (1 - 3750 / 9250) = 594.6 through 3750 armor; the WotLK constant 467.5 * 60 - 22167.5 = 5882.5 would leave 610.7. Level 61 players keep the WotLK rules: 1000 * (1 - 4047 / (4047 + 6350)) = 610.7, where the vanilla constant 5585 would leave 579.8.
